rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Available borrowing-entity liquidity is materially below the public headline amount.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Borrowing-entity cash map and forecast confirm unrestricted repayment liquidity.
rating_factors.rationale: Reported cash is large relative to the fictional request, subject to legal-entity availability and designated-cash limits.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Near-term maturities, secured borrowing, or refinancing needs increase materially.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Reconciled debt schedule shows durable maturity headroom and refinancing capacity.
rating_factors.rationale: Reported debt is substantial and includes identified near-term obligations and holder put exposure.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Operating cash use persists or exceeds the current historical reference.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: A current forecast and subsequent actuals demonstrate sustained positive operating cash generation.
rating_factors.rationale: The 2025 filing reported significant net cash used in operating activities.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Bitcoin price stress and issuer liquidity weaken together.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Repayment capacity is supported by stable cash generation without dependence on bitcoin value.
rating_factors.rationale: Headline liquidity includes material bitcoin exposure whose value and availability can change with crypto conditions.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Private diligence contradicts public-data assumptions or remains unavailable near funding.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: All repayment-capacity diligence items reconcile without a material unresolved exception.
rating_factors.rationale: Facility purpose, borrowing-entity forecast, legal-entity cash map, and complete debt schedule are unavailable.

rating_method_limit: The score is an illustrative ordinal bridge. It is not statistically calibrated and does not imply a probability of default, expected loss, or Coinbase policy.
rating_rationale: Reported liquidity is large relative to the request, but leverage, historical operating cash use, bitcoin exposure, and incomplete private diligence warrant heightened monitoring.
reversal_trigger: Increase only after a refreshed borrowing-entity cash forecast and debt schedule support repayment without collateral, or after additional eligible collateral raises the binding cap without another policy breach; decline if ownership, priority, control, price freshness, or the repayment route is not evidenced.
source_coverage_scope: All 13 material public filing facts used in the model and memo map to SRC-001 or SRC-002; this rate does not measure private-diligence completeness.

condition_register.requirement: Confirm no prior lien and first-priority perfected security.
condition_register.verification_method: Lien search, executed security documents, and legal confirmation

condition_register.requirement: Establish enforceable lender control over the collateral and custody account.
condition_register.verification_method: Executed control agreement and operating-procedure test

condition_register.requirement: Test the Base-to-liquidation-to-bank repayment route end to end.
condition_register.verification_method: Read-only route test with timestamps, fees, and destination confirmation

condition_register.requirement: Obtain and reconcile a current 13-week borrowing-entity cash forecast.
condition_register.verification_method: Forecast-to-bank and forecast-to-historical reconciliation

condition_register.requirement: Document facility purpose and a controlled use-of-proceeds schedule.
condition_register.verification_method: Approved sources-and-uses schedule tied to facility documents

condition_register.requirement: Map legal-entity cash ownership and transfer restrictions.
condition_register.verification_method: Entity chart, account map, and restriction review

condition_register.requirement: Reconcile the complete debt-service and maturity schedule.
condition_register.verification_method: Debt schedule tied to agreements, filings, and forecast cash flows

condition_register.requirement: Confirm current single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity.
condition_register.verification_method: Current portfolio report and limit-owner sign-off

conditions: beneficial ownership is verified
first-priority lien and control agreement are enforceable
Base-to-liquidation-to-bank repayment route passes an end-to-end test
13-week cash forecast and debt-service schedule support repayment
single-name and shared-risk concentration capacity is confirmed
exposure_basis: requested fully drawn recovery case plus accrued amount; not the recommended pro forma exposure

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Available borrowing-entity liquidity is materially below the public headline amount.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Borrowing-entity cash map and forecast confirm unrestricted repayment liquidity.
rating_factors.rationale: Reported cash is large relative to the fictional request, subject to legal-entity availability and designated-cash limits.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Near-term maturities, secured borrowing, or refinancing needs increase materially.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Reconciled debt schedule shows durable maturity headroom and refinancing capacity.
rating_factors.rationale: Reported debt is substantial and includes identified near-term obligations and holder put exposure.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Operating cash use persists or exceeds the current historical reference.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: A current forecast and subsequent actuals demonstrate sustained positive operating cash generation.
rating_factors.rationale: The 2025 filing reported significant net cash used in operating activities.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Bitcoin price stress and issuer liquidity weaken together.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: Repayment capacity is supported by stable cash generation without dependence on bitcoin value.
rating_factors.rationale: Headline liquidity includes material bitcoin exposure whose value and availability can change with crypto conditions.

rating_factors.deterioration_trigger: Private diligence contradicts public-data assumptions or remains unavailable near funding.
rating_factors.improvement_evidence: All repayment-capacity diligence items reconcile without a material unresolved exception.
rating_factors.rationale: Facility purpose, borrowing-entity forecast, legal-entity cash map, and complete debt schedule are unavailable.

rating_method_limit: The score is an illustrative ordinal bridge. It is not statistically calibrated and does not imply a probability of default, expected loss, or Coinbase policy.
rating_rationale: Reported liquidity is large relative to the request, but leverage, historical operating cash use, bitcoin exposure, and incomplete private diligence warrant heightened monitoring.
reversal_trigger: Increase only after a refreshed borrowing-entity cash forecast and debt schedule support repayment without collateral, or after additional eligible collateral raises the binding cap without another policy breach; decline if ownership, priority, control, price freshness, or the repayment route is not evidenced.
source_coverage_scope: All 13 material public filing facts used in the model and memo map to SRC-001 or SRC-002; this rate does not measure private-diligence completeness.

calculation_trace.available_proceeds_formula: sum(max(0, stressed_gross - execution_cost - delay_cost - fixed_cost)) for eligible lots; blocked lots receive zero
calculation_trace.decision_formula: min(requested, obligor_cap, collateral_cap, single_name_cap, concentration_cap), or zero on hard blocker
